resources.string: A local camera for your agent. Use trusted Wi-Fi only: photos and pairing travel over plain HTTP, without encryption. Keep the phone plugged in for screen-off use. Press Stop when finished.
Frame the scene after pressing Start. Your camera stays off until then.
Press Start to get a pairing code
Connect to one private IPv4 Wi-Fi network to pair.
Camera permission is required. Grant it in app settings or press Start to retry.
Wi-Fi connection failed. Reconnect to retry.
Wi-Fi unavailable. Connect to your private Wi-Fi network.
Could not start. Press Start to retry.

Camera and pairing stay on your local network. Only Check for updates and Update contact GitHub and its download servers. They receive your IP address and request information; photos and pairing credentials are never sent. Mobile data may be used.
